description: Repeatable native/offline contract check for the Windows Codex app-server, pinned to the stable (non-experimental) JSON-RPC surface used by the maintained controller.
scope: Native Codex app-server over stdio on the target Windows host. No turn is sent, no model or provider is contacted, no relay or shared app-server is started, and no ACP or controller integration is exercised.
appServerArgsReason: Disabling the plugin, app and remote-plugin surfaces keeps startup local: no marketplace clone, no app catalogue fetch and no remote-control daemon. The lifecycle methods under test are unaffected.

trustModel.binaryLocation: owner-trusted fixed install location resolved from an absolute PATH entry (npm global shim -> vendored platform package)
trustModel.digestBinding: the resolved vendored file is hashed and compared to the pinned digest before any launch
trustModel.scope: This is not a general trust boundary and not a configurable seam. A different path containing the same bytes is accepted; different bytes are rejected. Installing, relocating or replacing the CLI remains an owner-managed action.

isolation.codexHome: owned temp directory, empty before start
isolation.project: owned temp directory containing only a qualification marker file
